spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

action.name: Storm Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Thunderbolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 500 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 2d12 + 9}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Deafened|SRD52} conditions until the start of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Lightning Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

entries.name: Storm Giant
entries: Among the tallest giants, storm giants live amid extreme forces of nature. In palaces at the bottom of the sea and castles floating amid the clouds, they revel in the power of mighty storms. When angered, they can shape the weather and call down devastating lightning. More often, though, these giants watch the rise and fall of nations and interpret supernatural omens, interfering in the world only when they're needed most.
